not_a_resumption_of.note: This track does not develop a self-training method. It closes an evaluator contract. The stop lock's prohibitions remain in force and are repeated below.

forbidden: retuning any threshold used by V1-V5
iterating model architecture against PAPER_EVAL results
long training runs without explicit user approval

selector_gates.coverage_rationale: A selector that returns POSE_UNRESOLVED on hard frames and scores well on the rest has not solved the problem. Accuracy without a coverage floor is gameable by discarding difficulty.

selector_inputs_allowed: fixed physical dimensions from the frozen registry
leakage_contract.gt_read_phase: GT parity is read only after every selection decision is complete
leakage_contract.deployed_selector_training_labels: synthetic only; real target-domain pose GT may never train a deployed selector
leakage_contract.why: the paper's training-condition sentence is 'without manually annotated target-domain pose labels during training'; training a deployed selector on real target yaw or axis GT would void it
leakage_contract.hyperparameters: frozen on synthetic development data; real SELECTOR_DEV is a sanity check only. Any departure from this is recorded in the paper.
leakage_contract.paper_eval_tuning: prohibited. PAPER_EVAL role is DEV, held_out_final is false, and it has been consumed by V1-V5 and every diagnostic track.

SELECTOR_DEV.requirement: image sha256 overlap with PAPER_EVAL must be 0

POSE_FINAL.role: untouched real evaluation, opened exactly once after the evaluator freezes
requirements: overlap 0 with PAPER_EVAL and every diagnostic population
overlap 0 with the self-training adaptation pool
image sha256 overlap 0, not merely different session names
POSE_FINAL.composition_preference: daytime and nighttime; plastic required; wood only if its symmetry and canonical contracts close

populations.known_hazard: DEV_POS140, the population the selector diagnostic ran on, is drawn from the same seven canonical eval sessions as PAPER_EVAL. It cannot serve as SELECTOR_DEV.

must_report_together: conditional pose error on resolved frames
unresolved_pose_handling.prohibited: silently dropping unresolved frames from the pose table

ordering.rule: strictly sequential; no step may start before the previous one passes
steps: STEP 2  wood symmetry and canonical closure
STEP 7  only then evaluate R0, R0-CONT, R1, R2, R3, R4, R5 with one evaluator
ordering.on_selector_fail: stop. Do not expand training or inference. POSE_METRICS_STATUS stays BLOCKED and the paper reports why.

prohibited: any state that opens a pose headline without every gate passing

claim_gate.note: A READY evaluator does not authorise the sentence 'self-training improves 6D pose'.
all_four_required: comparison fair (same evaluator, same population, exposure-matched arms)
uncertainty acceptable (paired comparison with an interval)
claim_gate.if_pose_does_not_improve: report it. The conclusion becomes: self-training improves detection and ranking, but neither 2D localisation nor 6D pose.

must_not_change: V1-V5 result JSON, per-frame CSV, checkpoints, teacher caches, pseudo manifests
_docs/paper/final/ documents until pose numbers actually exist
immutability.registry_note: the registry sha256 is pinned in roughly fifty places across the paper track; it is read-only for this work
immutability.placeholder_rule: no yaw, ADD, or IoU3D placeholder value may be inserted into any paper-facing document while this track is incomplete

first_pass_scope.if_auxiliary_selector_training_is_requir: report the expected cost and the exact data contract, then stop and wait for approval
